title: Formula for Power
text: The total power is $$P_{\text{total}}=P_{\text{pressure}}+P_{\text{kinetic}}+P_{\text{potential}}.$$ Here $$P_{\text{pressure}}=\Delta{}P\,Q,$$ $$P_{\text{kinetic}}=\tfrac12\rho{}v**2Q,$$ and $$P_{\text{potential}}=\rho{}Qgh.$$ Use $$\rho=1060\,\text{kg/m}**3$$ for blood and $$1\, \text{mm}\, \text{Hg}=133\, \text{Pa}, $$ and convert all lengths to meters.
